(b) On August 26, 2026, Helena B. Foulkes notified the Board of Directors (the “Board”) of Skillsoft Corp. (“Skillsoft”) of her resignation from the Board and all committees of the Board of which she is a member, effective August 31, 2026. Ms. Foulkes has served on the Board since June 2021 and was a member of the Audit Committee; Talent and Compensation Committee; and Nominating and Governance Committee. Ms. Foulkes’ resignation did not result from any disagreement with Skillsoft or its management on any matter relating to Skillsoft’s financials, operations, policies or practices. ​ SIGNATURES ​ Pursuant to the requirements of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the registrant has duly caused this report to be signed on its behalf by the undersigned hereunto duly authorized. ​ Dated: August 27, 2026 ​ SKILLSOFT CORP. ​ By: /s/ Ronald W.
